actualPublication.ui: Cards and table show title, employer, location, dates, salary/workplace, catalog mention chips and a direct View posting link, with attribution links where needed. They do not render the full description.
actualPublication.publicExports: data/jobs/jobs.json and jobs.ttl contain full normalized descriptions of published records. This assessment therefore covers description redistribution, not merely links or snippets.
actualPublication.privateDiagnostics: Per-source diagnostics and raw first-party payloads are excluded by promote_jobs_snapshot.py from the public data/jobs snapshot. The existing audit/replay archive pattern separately retains source material for review.
actualPublication.eligibility: Only qualified first-party records enter the public snapshot; review and not_match stay diagnostic.

observedProjectStandard.basis: Inference from root RDF approvals and recorded manager approvals, not a newly discovered blanket redistribution license.
observedProjectStandard.rule: Official publicly retrievable source, bounded reviewed contract, access/terms assessment, attribution and direct links, job-specific qualification, then explicit manager approval of the source. The recorded approvals do not uniformly require an express job-description redistribution license.

precedents.comparison: Same Ashby API guide and robots URL; provider public API contract used as terms evidence.
Same Teamtailor adapter, 64-request cap, and /data-privacy terms evidence pattern.
Approved same-site extraction uses privacy or imprint pages; no per-source express redistribution grant is represented in their approval contracts.
Same Greenhouse public API documentation and robots policy.

triplyTermsAssessment.finding: Section 1 frames client offers/proposals/assignments; section 6 governs software licensing. Section 24 retains intellectual property and restricts client copying. These are substantive restrictions and are not being ignored; the reviewed document does not specifically address public career indexing. Applying the established same-site admission standard supports an activation recommendation, without representing these terms as affirmative redistribution permission.

decision: Recommend all four sources for explicit activation approval under the existing project standard. The earlier generic deferrals applied a stricter express-permission threshold than the recorded approved comparators support. No source-specific access/republication prohibition was established by the reviewed evidence; absence of a prohibition is not a copyright license.
expectedCurrentPublication: Two qualified postings: one Databricks and one Triply. Artsy and Sage are monitoring feeds with zero current qualified postings. Two Databricks review records remain withheld.
authorization: This assessment does not set flags or authorize deployment. The manager must explicitly approve the exact four additions.
